Matt Parker

Photo of Matt Parker
Photo: © Rosemary Rance
Matt Parker is a stand-up comedian and a YouTuber with over one hundred million views. He is the author of the New York Times bestseller Love Triangle , international bestseller Humble Pi , and Things to Make and Do in the Fourth Dimension . Matt is also frequently seen, heard, and read on the Science Channel, on BBC radio, and in The Guardian, in that order. He has previously held world records for both the Rubik’s Cube and Space Invaders. In the pursuit of math, Matt has: flipped a coin 10,000 times, traveled to Antarctica, memorized π to hundreds of digits, and been bitten by a bullet ant in the Amazon rainforest. He has given math lectures at Cambridge University, Oxford University, Harvard University, and Lake Monger Primary School.
